description: Entities near a location: lat + lng, radius_km, an optional entity_type, limit. Each carries `source_tier`. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project. Optional filter; default all four.

fields.description: Only these keys in each row (plus id). Omit for all.

include_country_centroids.description: Also return country-centre placeholder pins (entities known only by country). Default false.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, -90 to 90 (WGS84). Required.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Up to 100. Default 20.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, -180 to 180 (WGS84). Required.

name: nearby
